summary: The validator compared calibration sample names after removing only a leading './', so a calibration evaluated on its fit sample written as 'work/./x.csv' passed ml.calibration_on_fit_sample.

impact.bias: a calibration validated on its own fit sample passed validation; the calibration metrics it reports are then optimistic
impact.trigger: fit_sample and validation.sample name one file, one of them with a '.' segment in the middle or a trailing separator, and no recorded sample_check hashes or disjointness showing the overlap

remedy: validate the artifact again with a release that has the fix (python3 <plugin root>/contracts/validate.py <artifacts_dir>)
